summary: Kennedy-Wilson Holdings, Inc. disclosed pricing of a $1.8B senior notes offering by its subsidiary to facilitate a going-private merger. The Merger Agreement, dated February 16, 2026, as amended, involves the Company merging with an entity affiliated with Chairman/CEO William McMorrow and other senior executives, including Fairfax Financial Holdings. The notes consist of $1.1B of 7.000% notes due 2031 and $700M of 7.250% notes due 2033. Proceeds will redeem existing notes upon merger consummation, with an escrow and special mandatory redemption provision if the merger fails by November 16, 2026. Watch for regulatory approval, stockholder vote, and risk-arb spread.
